characters.name: Eldrin

class_features.name: Channel Divinity
class_features.description: 2 Uses, Regain 1x after Short Rest; all after Long Rest. Divine Spark: target in 30 ft. heals 1d8 + 3, or takes same Necrotic or Radiant damage; Spell Save DC CON save for half damage. Turn Undead: Undead within 30 ft., Spell Save DC WIS save or Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 min. or until damaged.

class_features.name: Preserve Life
class_features.description: Distribute 25HP among Bloodied targets within 30 ft.

class_features.name: Disciple of Life
class_features.description: Healing Spells add 2x Spell Slot level to HP recovered.

species_traits.name: Dwarf Traits
species_traits.description: Darkvision (120 feet); Dwarven Resilience (Resistance + Advantage against Poison); Dwarven Toughness (extra hit points, included); Stonecunning (gain Tremorsense 60 ft. for 10 min. as a bonus action, 3x/Long Rest)

feats.name: Healer
feats.description: Healing kit allows treated creature to use one Hit Point Die to recover HP. Also, dice for healing (kit or magic) reroll 1 results.

equipment: priest's pack (backpack, a blanket, 10 candles, a tinderbox, an alms box, 2 blocks of incense, a censer, vestments, 2 days rations, waterskin)
herbalism kit (clippers, mortar and pestle, pouches and vials of herbs)

characters.name: Grruk

class_features.name: Unarmored Defense
class_features.description: AC while not wearing armor = 10 + DEX mod + CON mod.

class_features.name: Weapon Mastery
class_features.description: Cleave: On hit, once per turn attack second target within 5 ft. for 1d12 slashing damage. Vex: On hit, gain adv. on next attack on target before end of next turn.

class_features.name: Rage
class_features.description: 3/Long Rest. Bonus action to begin, lasts 10 minutes. Advantage on STR checks and saves, +2 bonus on STR-based melee damage, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. No spellcasting or concentration.

class_features.name: Danger Sense
class_features.description: Advantage on DEX saves against effects you can see.

class_features.name: Reckless Attack
class_features.description: Advantage on attack rolls during your turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.

class_features.name: Frenzy
class_features.description: When raging and using Reckless Attack, the first weapon hit on your turn deals extra damage equal to your Barbarian level (3 damage).

species_traits.name: Orc Traits
species_traits.description: Adrenaline Rush (Dash as a Bonus Action and gain Temp. HP equal to Prof. Bonus, a number of times per Long/Short Rest equal to Prof. Bonus); Darkvision 120 ft.; Relentless Endurance (When reduced to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP instead once per Long Rest).

equipment: Explorer's pack (backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, 10 torches, 10 days' rations, waterskin, 50 feet of hempen rope)

characters.name: Wood Elf Ranger

class_features.name: Favored Enemy
class_features.description: Cast Hunter's Mark 2/Long Rest without expending a spell slot.

class_features.name: Weapon Masteries
class_features.description: Slow: On damage, target's speed reduced by 10 ft. Vex: On hit, adv. on next hit against target.

class_features.name: Hunter's Lore
class_features.description: Learn resistance, immunity, vulnerability of Hunter's Mark target.

class_features.name: Hunter's Prey
class_features.description: Pick one after Long/Short Rest: Colossus Slayer (once per turn, deal 1d8 extra damage to target with missing HP) or Horde Breaker (once per turn, make another attack against a different creature within 5 ft. of target).

species_traits.name: Wood Elf Traits
species_traits.description: Darkvision 60 ft.; Elven Lineage (Druidcraft cantrip, Longstrider, Pass without Trace each once per Long Rest or via spell slot); Fey Ancestry (Adv. vs. Charmed); Trance (4 hrs. as 8 hrs. sleep).

feats.name: Sharpshooter
feats.description: No disadv. on Ranged Attacks in melee, ignore half and three-quarters cover, no disadv. for long range.

equipment: Explorer's pack (backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, 10 torches, 10 days' rations, waterskin, 50 feet of hempen rope)
